text: Program Introduction The MBBS program is run on a six-year duration. This comes with the first 5 years that entails a total of 10 semesters with the last twelve months being the internship year that is compulsory for all students. There is an early introduction to pre-clinical topics which provides the basis for medical studies in the subsequent years. In the two years students have to grasp the necessary knowledge that is applied during clinical training. Success in medicine requires application and hard work, both while studying and when in practice. However it brings great rewards in terms of job satisfaction, involving a combination of science and human interactions. Main Courses 1. Public courses: Chinese (intensive reading, listening and oral Chinese), brief introduction of China, healthy education. 2. Basic specialized courses: System Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, Physiology, Biochemistry,Cell Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Pathology, Path physiology, Medical Genetics, Nutrition, Pharmacology, Social Medicine, Preventive Medicine, Local Anatomy, Health Statistics, Parasitological,Traditional Chinese Medicine. 3. Specialized courses: Diagnostics, Medical Imaging, Forensic Medicine, Clinical Immunology, Internal Medicine, Surgery, Emergency Medicine, Clinical Anesthesiology, Epidemiology, Ophthalmology, Oral Sciences, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, Neurology, Infectious Diseases, Skin Epidemiology, Otolaryngology, Obstetrics and Gynecology. 4. Practice: fundamental medicine basic skills experiments, clinical fundamental skills practice, clinical practice. Please click here to view the curriculum of the MBBS program. Or click here to download the curriculum of the MBBS program. Internship The total duration of internship is 48 weeks basis. During intership, the concerned departments will lay emphasis on the practical experience of the student.
